REFERENCE ATLAS

Evidence and assumptions

Size basis

The legacy manufacturer brochure, p. 7 lists 810 × 974 × 651 mm (W × D × H) without a documented datum for the modeled assembly. The corresponding 810 × 974 mm envelope is nominal, not a measured installed footprint.

Exact in this ideal model

Projected width is |W·cos θ| + |L·sin θ|. The calculation checks every authored pose, the endpoints and interior extrema of each turn, and cardinal cusps. It assumes an undeformed rectangular envelope, straight parallel walls, and fixed lateral offset. No handling procedure, ultrasound, anatomy, appliance operation, or reliable physical fit is represented.
